مَخْفِضُ قَوْمٍ A place where a people are in a state of ease, or tranquillity; or in a plentiful and pleasant state of life. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also خَفْضٌ, in the latter part of the paragraph. ＝
-A2- مَخْفِضٌ also signifies The place of a girl where the operation of circumcision is performed. (Lh and Az, in TA, voce عُذْرَة.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
